rule.statistic: median and 1.4826*MAD of the reference windows, clip at +-20
rule.training: leave-streamed-patient-out on dev detection clips; each training patient normalized by its earliest third of negative clips (same statistic)
rule.inclusion: a development patient's stream is scored if, after its first 30 min of non-ictal windows (removed as the fixed baseline), it contains >= 1 ictal window
rule.event_threshold: per stream, the 90th percentile of the other scored streams' scores in the same arm (10% time in warning)
rule.smoothing: causal moving average over windows starting in (t-120 s, t]

endpoints.primary: feat_gbm: per-stream AUC(refreshed) - AUC(none) over streams not in ORIGINAL; two-sided sign-flip test, alpha 0.05
secondary: event sensitivity, false alarms per 24 h, median latency at the transferred threshold, raw and smoothed
